name: 98512 · Tumwater, WA
findings: ZIP 98512 (Tumwater) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 32 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98512 (Tumwater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98512 (Tumwater) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
